verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party pricing documentation, plan limits, or cost-predictability guarantees from Algolia, so nothing shows that costs stay predictable as records and queries grow. Community reports point the other way: users call it too expensive at scale for large indexes, criticize the per-search pricing model for live-search UIs, and note that sort-by replica indexes multiply record usage (30K records became 150K). With no vendor claim to contradict, this is a lack of support rather than a dispute.
